paragraphs.text: Night trains were disappearing across Europe until about 2016. Airlines were cheaper, and the carriages were old and expensive to keep.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Two things changed. Passengers began to count the hours as well as the fare, and several governments started to tax flights while leaving rail untaxed.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: New carriages are being built with small single cabins, because most night passengers travel alone and dislike sharing with strangers. Older stock had six-berth compartments.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Problems remain. A night train earns money only if it runs full every night, and crossing three countries means three sets of rules, three timetables and long stops at borders.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: New carriages are being built with small single cabins, because most night passengers travel alone
items.prompt: a design change that follows what passengers want

explanation.en: Single cabins answer what passengers want — paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Бір орындық купе — жолаушы тілегіне жауап, C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Одноместные купе — ответ на желание пассажиров, абзац C.

items.quote: crossing three countries means three sets of rules, three timetables and long stops at borders
items.prompt: a difficulty caused by crossing borders

explanation.en: Three countries mean three sets of rules — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Үш ел — үш ереже жиынтығы, D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Три страны — три набора правил, абзац D.

items.quote: Airlines were cheaper, and the carriages were old and expensive to keep

explanation.en: Cheap flights and old carriages caused the decline — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Арзан ұшақ пен ескі вагон — құлдырау себебі, A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Дешёвые самолёты и старые вагоны — причина упадка, абзац A.

items.quote: several governments started to tax flights while leaving rail untaxed
items.prompt: a decision by governments that helped rail

explanation.en: Taxing flights helped rail — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Ұшаққа салынған салық теміржолға көмектесті — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Налог на авиабилеты помог железной дороге — абзац B.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
